AI & Automation Hub

Enterprise AI orchestration layer supporting PM / Intake, ASTM Governance, inspections, analysis, QA, reporting, reserve forecasting, workflow automation, and governance. This is not a chatbot; it is a governed intelligence layer across BuildSphere.

Human Oversight Required

AI may recommend, analyze, forecast, draft, validate, and automate. AI may not release reports, override governance, modify audit logs, approve deliverables, or change subscription status.
